title: Sweep MATRIX_LR (Muon LR) 0.04->0.03
description: Lowered MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03, all else unchanged from baseline (ASPECT_RATIO=96, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2^18, DEPTH=8)
reflection: val_bpb 0.982470 vs baseline 0.982558 - within the ~0.00023 noise band established by round 2's 6 identical-config runs. Effectively a no-op; MATRIX_LR=0.04 appears fine at the current model shape/step count, or the true optimum is a smaller step (e.g. 0.035) that this coarse probe couldn't resolve. Not worth chasing further with a symmetric bracket unless someone wants to spend a slot on a finer grid; better to prioritize other untested axes (WARMDOWN_RATIO/FINAL_LR_FRAC, EMBEDDING_LR).
